texto_ingles: {span 06 d001 3e 08}A wicked sword quenched in the blood of Fafnir the Darkwyrm.

texto_ingles: {span 0c 7002 3d 08}A heavy sword with a long handle, designed to fully utilize the strength of both hands to deliver potent slashing attacks.

texto_espanol_nuevo: Magnífica hoja hallada en las ruinas de un antiguo reino, hace mucho tragado por las arenas del desierto de Dalmuhd.

texto_ingles: {span 0c 1202 35 08}A large sword with quicksilver core, favored by lictors belonging to the Guild of Seekers for Truth and Repentance.

texto_espanol_nuevo: Espada grande con núcleo de mercurio, preferida por los lictores pertenecientes al Gremio de Buscadores de la Verdad y el Arrepentimiento.

texto_ingles: {span 0a de02 2f 08}Little more than a slab of iron, this Dragon Lord blade deals death mostly by its immense size and weight.
ubicaciones: [{"archivo":"battle/battle_data_release/battle_text.xlc","tipo":"XLC","fila":"106","columna":"8","id_entrada":"","nid":"","texto_ingles_original":"{span 0a de02 2f 08}Little more than a slab of iron, this Dragon Lord blade deals death mostly by its immense size and weight.","texto_espanol_actual":"","contexto_anterior":"","contexto_siguiente":""}]
texto_espanol_nuevo: Poco más que una losa de hierro, esta espada del Señor Dragón causa la muerte principalmente por su enorme tamaño y peso.

texto_ingles: {span 0a 5e02 21 08}A sword with a large, double-edged blade imbued with the power of Notos, God of the South Wind.
ubicaciones: [{"archivo":"battle/battle_data_release/battle_text.xlc","tipo":"XLC","fila":"108","columna":"8","id_entrada":"","nid":"","texto_ingles_original":"{span 0a 5e02 21 08}A sword with a large, double-edged blade imbued with the power of Notos, God of the South Wind.","texto_espanol_actual":"","contexto_anterior":"","contexto_siguiente":"{span 0c 3002 35 08}A flaming sword crafted from dragonglass, sharper than steel and heavily enchanted to prevent shattering."}]

texto_espanol_nuevo: Espada llameante fabricada con vidrio de dragón, más afilada que el acero y encantada intensamente para evitar que se rompa.

texto_ingles: {span 0a 2202 1f 08}This sacred blade is said to have been wielded by Ijana, one of the Twelve Heavenly Generals.
ubicaciones: [{"archivo":"battle/battle_data_release/battle_text.xlc","tipo":"XLC","fila":"110","columna":"8","id_entrada":"","nid":"","texto_ingles_original":"{span 0a 2202 1f 08}This sacred blade is said to have been wielded by Ijana, one of the Twelve Heavenly Generals.","texto_espanol_actual":"","contexto_anterior":"{span 0c 3002 35 08}A flaming sword crafted from dragonglass, sharper than steel and heavily enchanted to prevent shattering.","contexto_siguiente":"{span 0c 0c02 36 08}This sacred blade is said to have been gifted by the hosts of heaven to the Holy Knight Laurent in his hour of need."}]

texto_ingles: {span 0c 9202 3c 08}A legendary greatsword said to leave a rainbow-like arc when swung and is capable of slicing the top off a mountain.

texto_ingles: {span 0a f802 34 08}A light axe that sits comfortably in one hand, still capable of inflicting high damage.
